description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Physical Inventory Document provides a way to interact with the [Physical Inventory Documents - Read, Create API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_PHYSICAL_INVENTORY_DOC_SRV/overview). The service allows to read and create physical inventory documents.
key-features: Create physical inventory documents to plan stock counts
Read physical inventory document headers and items
Read serial numbers recorded on physical inventory documents
